```sql
WITH wiggins_geometry AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Wiggins' AND addr_state ILIKE 'Colorado'
),
wiggins_dem AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM wiggins_geometry), TRUE) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM wiggins_geometry))
),
wiggins_slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, 'DEGREE') AS slope_rast
  FROM wiggins_dem
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS avg_slope_degrees
FROM (
  SELECT
    (ST_SummaryStats(slope_rast, TRUE)).*
  FROM wiggins_slope_raster
) AS stats;
```
